# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Publish README badges (main only — data lives on the 'badges' branch)
        # Dynamic shields.io endpoint badges: the numbers come from this run, the JSON lives on an
        # orphan 'badges' branch, so nothing in the code tree changes (no PR conflicts, no bot
        # commits on main). Cosmetic — never fails the pipeline.
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/releases/download/v0.15.0/crap4dart-linux-x64 \
            -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap4dart-linux-x64" && chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap4dart-linux-x64"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap4dart-linux-x64" check --only similarity --format json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/md-similarity-check.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap4dart-linux-x64" similarity --jaccard 0.01 --containment 0.01 --format json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/md-similarity-all.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          node - <<'JS'
          const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path');
          const tmp = process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, thr = Number(process.env.CRAP_THRESHOLD);
          const cov = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'cov/coverage-final.json'), 'utf8'));
          let t = 0, h = 0;
          for (const [f, e] of Object.entries(cov)) {
            if (/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(f)) continue;       // product code only
            for (const k in e.s) { t++; if (e.s[k] > 0) h++; }
          }
          const report = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'crap-all.txt'), 'utf8');
          const rows = report.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim().split(/\s+/)).filter((c) => c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1])));
          const scores = rows.map((c) => parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
          const max = Math.max(0, ...scores), over = scores.filter((x) => x > thr).length;
          const pct = t ? Math.round((1000 * h) / t) / 10 : 0;
          const colorMax = max <= 12 ? 'brightgreen' : max <= 30 ? 'yellow' : max <= 200 ? 'orange' : 'red';
          const colorOver = over === 0 ? 'brightgreen' : over <= 25 ? 'yellow' : over <= 150 ? 'orange' : 'red';
          const colorCov = pct >= 90 ? 'brightgreen' : pct >= 80 ? 'green' : pct >= 70 ? 'yellowgreen' : pct >= 50 ? 'yellow' : 'orange';
          const out = path.join(tmp, 'badges');
          fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
          const w = (n, label, message, color) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, n), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, label, message, color }) + '\n');
          w('crap-max.json', 'CRAP max', String(Math.round(max * 10) / 10), colorMax);
          w('crap-over.json', `CRAP > ${thr}`, `${over} fns`, colorOver);
          w('coverage.json', 'coverage', `${pct}%`, colorCov);
          let mdPairs = 0, maxJaccard = 0;
          try {
            const sim = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'md-similarity-check.json'), 'utf8'));
            const gate = (sim.gates || []).find((g) => g.id === 'similarity') || {};
            mdPairs = Array.isArray(gate.violations) ? gate.violations.length : 0;
          } catch (_) {}
          try {
            const allSim = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'md-similarity-all.json'), 'utf8'));
            const pairs = Array.isArray(allSim.pairs) ? allSim.pairs : [];
            if (pairs.length > 0) maxJaccard = Math.max(0, ...pairs.map((p) => Number(p.jaccard) || 0));
          } catch (_) {}
          const maxPct = Math.round(maxJaccard * 100);
          const mdMsg = mdPairs === 0 ? `max ${maxPct}% (0 over 50%)` : `max ${maxPct}% (${mdPairs} over 50%)`;
          const mdColor = mdPairs > 0 ? 'red' : maxJaccard <= 0.35 ? 'brightgreen' : maxJaccard <= 0.45 ? 'green' : 'yellow';
          w('md-similarity.json', 'md similarity', mdMsg, mdColor);
          console.log(`badges: max=${max} over=${over} coverage=${pct}%`);
          JS
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/badges"
          git init -q && git checkout -q -b badges
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'; git config user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A && git commit -q -m "badges: main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push -q -f "https://x-access-token:[REDACTED:Connection String Password]@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" badges

      - name: Label PR (crap:regression / crap:improved)
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          OUTCOME: ${{ steps.ratchet.outcome }}
          IMPROVED: ${{ steps.ratchet.outputs.improved }}
        run: |
          if [ "$OUTCOME" = "failure" ]; then
            gh pr edit "$PR" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --add-label crap:regression || true
          elif [ "$OUTCOME" = "success" ]; then
            gh pr edit "$PR" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label crap:regression || true
